bugs.rationale: RUSTSEC-2020-0113: AtomicOption<T> exposes `unsafe impl<T> Sync for AtomicOption<T>` with no `T: Send` bound. Holding `AtomicOption<NonSend>` across threads + calling `.take()` lets a non-Send value (e.g. Rc, RefCell) cross the thread boundary -- a send-bound violation that leads to data races on the inner value's interior mutability. Unmaintained; no upstream fix.
